dataset.note: Added the missing 750,000 events: 300,000 Møller and 450,000 ep inelastic. Deconvolution now uses 9 million events, 3 million per interaction. Updated dilutions, correlations, covariance, deconvolution and propagated MC errors; unchanged cuts, response models and exposure. Other viewer datasets unchanged.
limitations: Finite MC may make conditional fit errors optimistic; nominal coverage is not established for this dataset
Expected PE only; additional optical and electronics fluctuations are not included
